findings.title: Default `queued` timestamp on `AssignmentSource` is evaluated once at import time
findings.body: In `AssignmentSource`, `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` calls `timezone.now()` once when the module is imported rather than when each `AssignmentSource` instance is created. As a result, every `AssignmentSource` created without an explicit `queued` value will share the worker's module-import timestamp instead of recording when the assignment was actually queued. Use `dataclasses.field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so the timestamp is generated per instance.

findings.title: `assignment_source` parameter added to `sync_status_outbound` instead of `sync_assignee_outbound`
findings.body: `IssueSyncIntegration.sync_status_outbound` was updated to accept `assignment_source: AssignmentSource | None = None`, whereas the task in `src/sentry/integrations/tasks/sync_assignee_outbound.py` (line 60) passes `assignment_source=parsed_assignment_source` to `installation.sync_assignee_outbound(...)`. `sync_status_outbound` handles resolution status changes and never receives `assignment_source`, while `IssueSyncIntegration.sync_assignee_outbound` was left without the parameter in its signature (only accepting it via `**kwargs`).
